planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno. Wiring preserved per authoritative pins: TM1637 clk=D4 dio=D5, potentiometer analog input on A1, button on D2. D2 uses INPUT_PULLUP; model is true when pressed via digital_input.active_high=true (as assumed in prior contract).

A0 was present in the authoritative pin list and the validator indicated it was omitted; therefore a catalog analog_input port for A0 is added to own that exact pin. No specific business role for A0 was provided, so SysML behavior for this signal is left to the model.
Default display behavior requires converting potentiometer analog_input (A1) to a TM1637_number integer in the SysML model (scaling/rounding/clamping unspecified).
No serial reporting or serial command inputs are required by the provided requirements.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Potentiometer ADC value to display on TM1637 by default

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Button press input: when pressed display 8888 on TM1637

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 numeric display: default shows potentiometer value; on button press shows 8888

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Unspecified A0 pin (placeholder port to represent existing wired capability per validator)
